lead.event: IDX to exclude 383 high-shareholding-concentration stocks from IHSG calculations
lead.headline: IDX begins gradual exclusion of 383 stocks from IHSG calculations
lead.blurb: The exchange classifies stocks as highly concentrated when 10 or fewer shareholders hold at least 92.5% of their shares. The rules took effect on 13 November and now cover all listed companies, dropping the previous Rp5 trillion market-capitalization floor and Price Impact Ratio test. IDX President Director Jeffrey Hendrik said concentrated ownership can make stocks more vulnerable to price fluctuations in large-volume trades and create tracking error risk for passive investors. He said the designation aims to improve ownership transparency, not indicate a market violation.
